title: Token to Goal: 3 by 3 Grid Puzzle
description: A flat 3 by 3 board of grey tiles seen from above and in front. A blue sphere token starts on the bottom-left square; an orange raised marker labelled Goal sits on the top-right square. Up, Down, Left and Right buttons move the token one square. Hint shows a green arrow from the token along a move that brings it one step closer to the goal. Readouts give moves made and steps to goal.

game.objective: Move the token from the bottom-left square to the orange goal square on the top-right.
game.hint: Each move changes one row or one column. The goal is 2 columns right and 2 rows up, so the shortest route is 4 moves.

assumptions: This is a simple made-up puzzle, not a model of anything real.
The token moves only up, down, left or right, never diagonally, so 'steps to goal' counts the up/down steps plus the left/right steps (taxicab distance).
The token starts on the bottom-left square and the goal is the top-right square, so the shortest route takes 4 moves.
Once the token reaches the goal, the game is won and the move buttons stop working until you press Reset.
The start and goal never change; Reset puts the token back on the same start. The board has no walls, so the hint simply points toward the goal.
